faq_intro: Learn how Nawaya helps you grow, earn, and connect - whether you're here to learn from others or guide them toward their next step.
faq_1_q: What makes Nawaya different from online courses?
faq_1_a: Nawaya is built around real human connection. Instead of watching content alone, you learn with Guides, join live sessions, and grow alongside others - with feedback, interaction, and accountability.
faq_2_q: How do I find the right Guide?
faq_2_a: You can get matched based on your goals and interests, or explore Guide profiles, backgrounds, and offerings to choose who resonates with you most.
faq_3_a: Most sessions are live to encourage interaction and connection. Some programs may include recordings or follow-up material, depending on the Guide.
faq_4_q: How much does it cost to use Nawaya?
faq_4_a:
Nawaya is available for $19.99 per month. This gives you access to the platform, community features, and the ability to join programs and live sessions hosted by Guides.
Individual sessions or programs may be priced separately by Guides, depending on the format and depth.
faq_5_q: Can I switch or message my guide after booking?
faq_5_a: Yes. You can message your Guide directly, ask questions, and switch paths if your needs change. Growth should feel flexible, not locked in.

guide_cta_sub: Create your profile, share your expertise, and connect with learners who are ready to grow. Nawaya makes it simple to begin and meaningful to continue.
guide_faq_1_q: How do I become a guide on Nawaya?
guide_faq_1_a: Create a profile and join the waitlist. Once approved, you’ll be able to set up sessions, programs, or circles and start guiding.
guide_faq_2_q: Do I need prior coaching experience?
guide_faq_2_a: No formal coaching title is required. What matters is real-world experience and a desire to help others grow. All Guides on Nawaya go through a screening and verification process to ensure trust and quality.
guide_faq_3_q: How do I earn from sessions or programs?
guide_faq_3_a: You earn by hosting paid sessions, programs, or community experiences. Nawaya takes a small platform fee to support discovery, tools, and payments.
guide_faq_4_q: Can I set my own prices and schedule?
guide_faq_4_a: Yes. You’re fully in control of your pricing, availability, and format.
guide_faq_5_q: How does Nawaya help me get discovered?
guide_faq_5_a: Nawaya matches Guides with learners based on goals, interests, and relevance - so the right people find you without needing a large audience.
